mapper.select: select DISTINCT `date` from t_index_raw teni where stockCode = '1.000001' and `date` >= '2022-01-01' and not exists (select 1 from t_stock_boll t2 where teni.`date` = t2.date) order by 1 limit 1
mapper.insert: replace into t_stock_boll(date, stockCode, last, mb_20, boll_up_20, boll_dn_20) WITH boll_calculation AS ( SELECT `date` , stockCode, `last` , -- 1. 计算20日移动平均线（中轨） AVG(`last` ) OVER( PARTITION BY stockCode ORDER BY `date` ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS mb_20, -- 2. 计算20日总体标准差（MySQL的 STDDEV_SAMP 函数） STDDEV_SAMP(`last`) OVER( PARTITION BY stockCode ORDER BY `date` ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS std_dev_20 , rank() over (partition by stockCode order by `date` desc) date_rank FROM t_stock_raw where date > '2026-08-01' and stockCode = '0.000001' ) , tmp_boll as ( SELECT `date` , stockCode, `last` , ROUND(mb_20, 4) AS mb_20, -- 中轨 ROUND(mb_20 + (2 * std_dev_20), 4) AS boll_up_20, -- 上轨 ROUND(mb_20 - (2 * std_dev_20), 4) AS boll_dn_20 -- 下轨 FROM boll_calculation -- where date_rank <= 1 ) select `date`, stockCode, `last`, mb_20, boll_up_20, boll_dn_20 from tmp_boll t ORDER BY date, stockCode
